name: Squad Screen MVP
install: bash -lc 'set -e; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install; nvm use; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which current)"):$PATH"; node --version; npm install'

terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install; nvm use; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which current)"):$PATH"; node --version; npm run dev'
